name: Dilgo_kyentse_benchmark_combined
description: A benchmark constructed from texts and tasks related to the Dilgo Kyentse corpus that measures language understanding and generation on domain-specific (Tibetan/Buddhist) content. It evaluates models' ability to answer questions, produce translations or summaries, and perform classification on passages drawn from the corpus. The benchmark emphasizes cultural and religious text comprehension rather than general-domain language tasks.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific dataset with limited but growing use among researchers working on Tibetan and Buddhist text processing.
